brief.headline: Push for a 12% price cut in exchange for faster payment — they keep 5.9% profit vs 3.8% peers, and their cash is stuck 104d vs 79d peer average

priceAsk.summary: Ask for a price cut of roughly 12% in exchange for paying them faster
priceAsk.basis: They keep 5.9% profit vs 3.8% for similar firms — so there's room. Market asking prices for 28 mm caps (₹0.55–1.20/pc, typical ₹0.85–0.95) are MARKET-FAIR with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume. They borrow money at 12.19%, so paying them faster is worth that rate to them — tie the price cut to faster payment.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay in 15 days (cutting our payment time in half) in return for the 12% price cut

brief.financialLeverage: They are healthy — CRISIL A+ / Stable rating, they keep 5.9% of every ₹100 they sell (vs 3.8% for peers), and they're growing fast (22.1%/yr). But their cash is stuck for 104d vs 79d for similar firms, so cash is tight for them. We are a tiny customer — just 0.59% of their ₹937.60 Cr revenue — so we can't bully them, but we can offer a swap: faster payment (15 days vs current 30) in exchange for a price cut roughly the size of their 12.19% borrowing rate. They already take 49d to pay their own suppliers vs 37d peer average, so asking for extended terms won't fly — instead, use quicker payment as the carrot.
